answer: Context-bound answer sampling. Each identity must answer a fresh nonce-derived challenge whose decoding depends on its own prior outputs, so any copied or precomputed response fails and queries a hollow channel. A valid reply leaves a cryptographic ripple tied to that identity's local state, which verifiers check against a shared ocean of recent challenge histories. Attackers must run distinct live inference per identity, paying full compute plus latency per attempt, and cannot amortize across sybils.
